thread:
maria_g: FYI customer Acme (acct: ACME-42) reporting ~40 users lost access after an Okta group rename this morning. SCIM logs show deprovision events but role assignments are gone. Anyone seen a group->role shadowing issue?

samir_r: looking now. can you paste a sample SCIM payload or mapping? specifically is externalId set on the Okta groups?

maria_g: here's the mapper we have on their account: ```{\"groupAttribute\":\"externalId\", \"role\":\"dev\"}``` They renamed the Okta group from `acme-devs` -> `acme-engineers` at 08:11 UTC. customer says legacy groups often had blank externalId.

alex_k: that rename pattern is risky — Okta will send a group \"replace\" with the new displayName. our mapper currently falls back to displayName if externalId is missing, which means a rename can break mapping at the moment of the replace.

maria_g: customer observed a SCIM PATCH that replaced members with an empty array right after the rename: they saw users removed in our UI and role attachments dropped.

csm-bot: Ticket #4567 created in support portal and linked to the account. Assigned to @samir_r.

samir_r: can you share the raw SCIM webhook logs (X-Request-Id) and one affected user id so I can trace? also need any Okta group audit entries.

maria_g: pasted log snippet into the ticket: ```2024-10-12T08:12:01Z INFO scim: PATCH /Groups id=00g12345 replace members -> [] request_id=xyz-abc``` affected user id `u-3345` lost role `dev`.

eng-oncall: quick triage notes: our group->role resolution priority is (1) externalId, (2) displayName. If externalId is blank and displayName changes, mapping won't match and current logic treats the empty-members replace as removal — leading to deprovisioning. we shouldn't auto-deprovision mapped roles on a single group.replace event without reconciling mapping keys.

alex_k: short-term mitigation: we can run a manual group restore sync for the org. internal admin API: ```POST /v1/orgs/acme/sync?mode=group-restore&dry_run=false``` (internal only). need customer consent.

maria_g: customer approved immediate restore but also reported 403s when trying admin operations via their delegated app.

samir_r: 403 is expected if the service token lost scim:group:write after our token rotation last night. looks like the delegated app wasn't updated with the new token scopes. pushing a fix to propagate correct scopes to delegated tokens.

eng-oncall: deployed token propagation fix at 08:45 UTC; new token includes scim:group:write and scim:user:patch. recommend manual retry once propagation completes (should be <5m).

alex_k: ran the manual restore with the customer's OK; logs show 38 role re-assignments. customer confirms access restored for 32 users, 6 still failing due to email alias mismatch on our side vs Okta.

maria_g: I'll send the alias resolution steps to customer. also request we add a guardrail: do not deprovision mapped roles on a solitary group.replace event when mapping key (externalId) is missing — we should queue for reconciliation instead.

samir_r: created ENG-7891: "SCIM: prevent role deprovision on displayName-only group replace" and linked PR and runbook. tagging @eng-runtime for ETA.

maria_g: customer asked for RCA and ETA; I'll update ticket #4567 with the timeline and the temporary manual fix performed. thanks team :relieved:

alex_k: follow-up action items: 1) add a reconciliation step before deprovision (ENG-7891), 2) alert when Okta group rename detected for orgs with blank externalId, 3) add automated dry-run on client to show which roles would be removed. I'll open follow-ups against eng-runtime and product.

maria_g: noted. I'll include those in the customer postmortem and share back the logs and ticket link.
